verdict.rationale: Marqeta docs show velocity/authorization spend controls and a Mastercard dispute-case API, plus transaction/webhook visibility that ops could use to react to suspicious activity, but there is no evidence of network fraud scores or Marqeta's own fraud models surfaced at authorization time, no dedicated suspicious-activity fraud alerts, and no documented card block/reissue workflow for compromised cards. missing for 10: fraud-score/model surfaced at auth, suspicious-activity fraud alerting, card block-and-reissue tooling.
